globBC_nElems_total_semantics.meaning: MPI_SUM of the initial per-rank boundary-element population over all levels for one boundary label
globBC_nElems_total_semantics.ownership: local partition boundary-property elements; MPI reduction supplies the global population
globBC_nElems_total_semantics.filter_timing: computed before remove_solid_in_bc and not recomputed afterward

local_nElems_semantics.meaning: rank-local boundary element list length for the current level
local_nElems_semantics.post_filter_update: remove_solid_in_bc rewrites nElems with nValid after removing prp_solid entries

pntIndex_semantics.registration_timing: boundary spacetime indices are registered after the boundary list is filtered
pntIndex_semantics.constant_scalar_shape: global constant supplies one evaluation entry per requested active element
pntIndex_semantics.zero: unregistered/invalid sentinel and not valid for an active sample
pntIndex_semantics.negative: invalid sentinel and not valid for an active sample
pntIndex_semantics.duplicates: positive duplicate registrations are permitted; each active boundary element still owns one sample slot
pntIndex_semantics.fine_observation: 375 positive, 375 unique, zero non-positive, zero duplicates

get_valOfIndex_invalid_index_semantics.portable_contract: provider-dependent and not a defined zero-fill operation
get_valOfIndex_invalid_index_semantics.constant_provider_detail: the constant provider fills requested results with its constant, but callers must still provide the registered active population
get_valOfIndex_invalid_index_semantics.fix_policy: fail before evaluation on a non-positive point index; never silently filter samples

mpi_ownership_semantics.numerator: MPI_SUM of samples for the current post-filter rank-local active lists
mpi_ownership_semantics.correct_denominator: MPI_SUM of those same post-filter rank-local active counts

pressure_boundary_active_set_semantics.elements: exactly globBC%nElems(iLevel), i.e. the post-filter active local list
pressure_boundary_active_set_semantics.links: only true D3Q19 bitmask entries are reconstructed and enter adaptive alpha/beta

conclusion: The old numerator and pressure reconstruction used the 375-element post-filter population while the denominator used the stale 376-element pre-filter population.
